question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    ELSE 'Multi-line order'
  END AS order_line_type,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS total_ordered_quantity,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_quantity_per_order
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

action.reason: Needed to calculate the share of each order type, including those with no item line, by getting the total number of orders in 2025.

action.query:
SELECT COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS orders_with_item_lines
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01';
action.reason: Needed to determine the number of orders with at least one item line, so we can infer the count of orders with no item line by subtracting from the total.

action.answer:
In 2025, all recorded orders (4,359,773) contained at least one item line; there were no orders with zero item lines in the data. 

- Multi-line orders (more than one item line): 3,052,089 orders, which is 70.03% of all orders. The average ordered units per multi-line order was 3.484769.
- One-line orders (exactly one item line): 1,307,684 orders, which is 29.97% of all orders. The average ordered units per one-line order was 1.219753.
- Orders with no item line: 0 orders (0.00%).

Interpretation: The vast majority of orders (70%) contained more than one item line, and these orders had a much higher average number of ordered units per order compared to single-line orders. There were no orders without item lines in the 2025 data. All shares are out of the total 4,359,773 orders. Units are in ordered item units per order.
